items.title: Airbnb's AI assistant cut support cost per booking 17% (1 minute read)
items.snippet: Airbnb's AI assistant cut support cost per booking by more than 17%, resolving about 40% of Q3 issues with no human agent.

items.title: Databricks Genie Agents (13 minute read)
items.snippet: Databricks Genie Agents can now analyze unstructured documents alongside database tables, connect to enterprise tools, and share insights externally with governance controls.
